title: Cups in tarot: Ace to Five meanings
description: Ace to Five of Cups in tarot: upright and reversed meanings for each card, how they form an emotional story, and how to use them in a tarot spread.

scenes.headline: Cups in tarot: Ace to Five meanings
scenes.caption: The Ace to Five of Cups follow feelings from an opening of the heart to loss and reappraisal. Each card has an upright and a reversed meaning.
scenes.vo: The Ace to Five of Cups follow feelings from an opening of the heart to loss and reappraisal. Each card has an upright and a reversed meaning.

scenes.headline: Ace of Cups
scenes.caption: New feeling, openness, emotional beginnings. A hand reaches from a cloud holding a cup that overflows with water, with a dove above it.
scenes.vo: Ace of Cups. New feeling, openness, emotional beginnings. A hand reaches from a cloud holding a cup that overflows with water, with a dove above it.

scenes.headline: Two of Cups
scenes.caption: Partnership, mutual respect, connection. Two figures exchange cups, and above them hovers a winged lion's head over a staff.
scenes.vo: Two of Cups. Partnership, mutual respect, connection. Two figures exchange cups, and above them hovers a winged lion's head over a staff.
